kind.instructions: What kind of change is this unit, judged by its main purpose?

criteria.config: changes configuration, build, CI or environment settings
criteria.dependency: adds, removes or bumps a dependency or lockfile entry
criteria.feature: adds or extends user-visible or API-visible functionality
criteria.formatting: whitespace, ordering or style only; no change in meaning
criteria.generated: machine-generated output such as codegen, snapshots or vendored files
criteria.perf: makes existing behaviour faster or cheaper
criteria.refactor: restructures code without changing what it does
criteria.test: adds or changes tests or test helpers

risk.instructions: How bad would it be if this change were wrong?

3: moderate, a visible bug for some users
4: high, broken core flow or wrong data
